findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_reports, get_report, search_organizations, get_organization, search_content, get_latest_news, list_topics · Private data: search_reports, get_report, funding_summary, about · Public sink: coverage_check, get_investor_scorecard · Destructive: search_content, list_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_reports, get_report, search_organizations, get_organization, search_content, get_latest_news, list_topics · Private data: search_reports, get_report, funding_summary, about · Public sink: coverage_check, get_investor_scorecard · Destructive: search_content, list_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
